claim: page-matches-its-type refuses person/device-token/pages/alan-alanwalton-5f1af6f94bab4b61e567d7b515432788.device-token.ts every round, its token running to 160 characters against the 64 device-token-token states. The repository holds four device-token pages and the other three carry tokens of exactly 64 characters, so the length stated fits what is normal and this one page carries something a normal registration does not produce. Widening the property to 160 would admit that token without anyone having established what it is, and would leave the check unable to say a malformed token from a long one. The page names iosApp ios-app/alanwalton, the same app as a 64-character token registered for the same person.

evidence:
Read on 2026-09-21 against this checkout.

The four pages and their tokens. alan-alanwalton-9eb5945453bf716327a14858607fb8b7 at 64 characters. jenny-smilingjenny-8589f4f9e46a096b7a8ac2c73f113b37 at 64. jenny-smilingjenny-16f329938cd7017a68f0fb49b8a3d70f at 64. alan-alanwalton-5f1af6f94bab4b61e567d7b515432788 at 160.

What the property states. person/device-token/properties/device-token-token.text-property.ts states maxLength 64. Sixty-four hexadecimal characters is thirty-two bytes, which is the length a device token has come back as for the other three.

What the round answered. The audit at 8403862d14f46ddffe7017fe6e8e16972a7c65cb had page-matches-its-type refuse that page once, reading `device-token-token` runs to 160 characters, over the length of 64. The refusal names a page that is landed and wrong rather than a file that moves, so it answers the same way every round until the page or the property changes.

What is unmeasured. What kind of token runs to 160 characters is not established here. A search of alan/web/modules and person/device-token for live-activity, liveActivity and pushToStart found nothing, and the page itself carries no field saying which kind of registration wrote it. Nothing here has asked Apple what it returned, and no commit has been read to see what wrote the page.
